Reality TV star Nicole "Snooki" Polizzi of Jersey Shore fame has traded New Jersey boardwalks for ghost-hunting in Ontario.

She’s the star of the new Crave series Snooki: The Paranormal Rookie, which follows her to some of the province's most haunted locations as she learns paranormal investigation alongside a psychic medium.

Snooki joins Q guest host Gill Deacon to discuss her lifelong interest in “ghosties” and aliens, her own experience with UFOs, and how she looks back on her time on Jersey Shore.
